browser: Microsoft Edge (headless, throwaway profile, muted) via Chrome DevTools Protocol on 127.0.0.1
method: Page.captureScreenshot, full page (captureBeyondViewport); bytes saved unmodified as PNG
read_only: Only the ticket list buttons were clicked (they issue GET requests). No dialog was opened.

original_record.note: byte-for-byte copy of the first capture_record.json, kept unedited

correction.error: The capture script selected the Activity list with '[role=list][aria-label="Agent activity"]'. The dashboard renders <ol aria-label="Agent activity">, whose list role is implicit (no role attribute), so the selector matched nothing. That gave 'events': 0, and because 'detail_loaded' required at least one event, 'detail_loaded': false for all three shots. Both values were wrong.
correction.fix: Selector corrected to ol[aria-label="Agent activity"] (scratchpad revalidate_shots.py).

revalidation.method: Headless Edge, throwaway profile, muted, same viewport and scale as the capture; read-only (only ticket list buttons clicked); NO new screenshots; counts from the page structure and the audit trail only.

correction.also_corrected: Claude's follow-up 45 note said each image shows the first '10-11' events; that was estimated from the images. The measured values are in activity_events.visible_in_scrollable_panel.
